_comment: What can and cannot be set programmatically, established by PROBING the live API on
2026-09-14 -- not by reading the docs, which are silent on all of it.
actor.json carries NO seo or pricing keys (verified against the actor-definition docs).
But the Actor API DOES accept them: PUT /v2/acts/{actorId} takes seoTitle,
seoDescription, categories, isPublic and pricingInfos. Two of those are gated on a
human prerequisite rather than on the docs' claim that the Console is the only route:
seoTitle/seoDescription/categories  APPLIED via the API. Already live on the Actor.
seoTitle is capped at 60 characters by the API.
isPublic: true                      HTTP 400 username-required -- the owning account
-- payout billing info (KYC) must exist first.
Once payout info exists, the pricing below can be applied in one API call with the
exact payload in `pricingInfoApiPayload`, no Console wizard needed.
The event names MUST match src/sink.js: charging an event the platform does not know
about returns an error. test/input.test.js pins the two lists together.
seoTitle: Mastodon & Bluesky Scraper - Profiles, Posts, Hashtags
seoDescription: Scrape Mastodon and Bluesky profiles, posts and hashtags via official public APIs. One normalized schema, no login, pay only for what you extract.

events.eventDescription: One account profile with follower, following and post counts, bio and avatar.
One post or boost with text, engagement counts, media, hashtags and mentions.

profile-scraped.eventDescription: One account profile with follower, following and post counts, bio and avatar.

post-scraped.eventDescription: One post or boost with text, engagement counts, media, hashtags and mentions.
